main_changes: The coordinator authorized main versions of zone_main_budget.py, zone_study_llm_driver.py, zone_study_llm_transport.py and agent_lock.py in the working tree. The cohort made zero model calls; agent_lock is host tooling. The EXECUTION closure always verifies the 4c6b439f blobs, so newer analysis-tree bytes do not replace executed bytes.
reexecution: Checkout 4c6b439f for re-execution of the recorded controller. The seal tree is for analysis/registration. This seal grants no new physical run and does not invent a prior registration receipt for the recorded cohort.
interpretation: Sealed while outcomes remain blinded, after data recording; not prospectively sealed before execution. Neither metadata completion nor passing offline checks is a task-success result.
